body.name: Constrained Markov efficiency handle
body.construction: Differentiate the polynomial equalities encoding absorption, the two-type Markov factorization, common untreated kernels, and the fifth-date restrictions to characterize \(\mathcal T_P\); project the saturated gradient \(G_p\) onto that score space and use the resulting normal equations as the starting point for constructing a regular estimator of \(\theta\).
